bullets.text: Simplified Carbon Reporting - **Sage** enhances carbon reporting for small businesses and accountants, promoting sustainability.
Cloud Payroll Acquisition - **Sage** acquires **Criterion** to enhance payroll and human capital management for mid-sized firms.
Guide to Making Tax Digital - **Sage** offers a free e-book to navigate the upcoming changes in income tax regulations.
New Leadership Appointment - **Sage** appoints Gretchen O’Hara to boost partner ecosystem and drive customer innovation.
